<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE Market Debut:</strong> The National Stock Exchange listed on the BSE and MSEI today, debuting at a modest premium over its IPO price before seeing some volatility in early trade.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Broad Market Sell-off:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty fell over 0.8% in early trade, led by losses in the financial sector, as investors reacted to macroeconomic headwinds.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
</ul>
